questions.Description: Develop and execute an assembly program on the 8051 trainer kit to perform arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division) of two numbers.
Write and test a program on 8051 to convert a given BCD number into its equivalent hexadecimal format.
Design and implement a program to generate and verify the parity bit for data transmission in 8051.
Using Timer 0, write a program to generate a square wave signal of 10 kHz on the 8051 microcontroller.
Interface a switch (or proximity sensor), LED, and relay with the 8051 microcontroller, and develop a program to test the interface.
Write an 8051 program to transfer data to an output port and verify the operation using trainer kit hardware.
Develop and test a program for interfacing a 7-segment LED display with the 8051 microcontroller to display numeric data.
Write and execute a program to interface a stepper motor with the 8051 microcontroller and control its rotation.
Develop a program on 8051 to display a string message on a 16×2 LCD module.
Write a program on PIC16F877A to generate a square wave output signal on a port pin.
Interface a relay with the PIC16F877A microcontroller and write a program to control its ON/OFF operation.
Develop and test a program to interface and control a DC motor using the PIC16F877A microcontroller.
